badfabb3cf.q: What is Ran Aroussi's approach to code review when using AI for large-scale code generation?
badfabb3cf.a: Ran stopped doing traditional code review approximately seven months ago due to the volume of code being generated. Instead, he writes code with Claude Opus and uses GPT-5 as the code reviewer after telling it that Opus wrote the code, finding that GPT-5 becomes more nitpicky and confrontational when it knows another model generated the code. He automates this process and relies on rigorous testing and end-to-end constraints rather than manual review.
